ShortDescription.Value: Find It is a mod that lets you quickly browse and search for all of the assets inside of the game.

Publish.LongDescription:
# Find It for Cities: Skylines II Quickly browse and search through all of the assets inside of the game.
Use **Ctrl+F** to quickly open the Find It panel, or click on the magnifier icon in your toolbar.
Use **Ctrl+P** to enable the Picker tool, or click on the picker icon in your toolbar.
Use **Ctrl+R** to select a random asset from the list, or click on the random button in the Find It panel.
Add **#tags** to your search to only show assets with all of those tags, for example `#park #bench modern`.
Huge thanks to **YenYang** for their help on the UI and **Algernon** for their contribution and allowing me to take on this project
And thank you to **Chameleon** for providing the icons, to **Morgan · Toverux** for their help with the optimizations, and to **Baka-gourd** (NullPinter) for their help with focus.
## Features * Quick and intelligent search methods. * Extensive sorting and filtering options. * Extensive and comprehensive asset categories. * Align the panel to the right to have unobstructed view of what you're working on. * Panel stays open while placing assets, no jumping between different tabs. * Tool options like Tree Controller and Line Tool are fully supported and can be used while the panel is open. * Favorite your most used assets. * Add your own tags to any asset, and quickly reuse the tags you've used before. * Search by tag, and combine several #tags with text to narrow down results. * Integrated Picker
## Notes Find It should automatically support any mods that add or alter the vanilla assets.
If you're having any issues, please report them on my discord as it's easier to help you that way.
## For Mod Developers
Find It exposes three APIs for other mods. No hard dependency is required — integration is done through reflection-based hooks that Find It calls automatically on startup.
### Prefab Picker API Opens Find It's picker window filtered to a specific prefab type and returns what the user selected as a Task.
Expose this method on your IMod class and Find It will call it on startup, handing you the picker delegate:
``` public static void SetFindItPrefabSelector(Func<Type, string, Task<PrefabBase>> selector) { _findItSelector = selector; } ```
Then call it whenever you need the user to pick a prefab:
``` // Filtered to TreePrefab — title auto-generates as "Tree Prefab" PrefabBase picked = await _findItSelector(typeof(TreePrefab), null);
// With a custom title PrefabBase picked = await _findItSelector(typeof(StaticObjectPrefab), "Select a Prop");
// Returns null if the user dismisses the picker without selecting ```
### Custom Search API Override Find It's search logic with your own matching function.
``` public static Func<string, bool> GetFindItSearchMethod(string searchText) { return name => name.Contains(searchText, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase); } ```
### Prefab Multi-Selection API Lets the active tool receive several prefabs at once: **Ctrl+click** toggles a prefab and **Shift+click** selects a range.
Expose these three public methods on your tool:
``` public void SelectPrefab(PrefabBase prefab); public void DeselectPrefab(PrefabBase prefab); public List<PrefabBase> GetSelectedPrefabs(); ```
## For Asset Creators
Select your asset in the editor and click the **Find It Properties** button (the tag icon) in the editor's bottom bar to set:
* **Tags** that players can find with a #tag search. Players can't remove them, and Find It doesn't save them. * **Category** to place the asset in a specific Find It sub-category. * **Hide from Find It** to keep the asset out of Find It completely.
You can choose where they're saved:
* **Standard:** in the FindItProperties component, with every option available. If the asset is edited and saved again without Find It enabled, these properties will be lost. * **More Compatibility:** as # entries in the Editor Asset Category Override component. Only tags and the category are available, but they're kept even if the asset is edited without Find It.
Full documentation and examples are available on the GitHub page.
Publish.ChangeLog:
*Custom Tags! And optimizations brought to you thanks to Morgan · Toverux.*
## Custom Tags * Added custom tags support on any asset to easily group the or find them more easily. * Searching has been upgraded to also matches your custom tags. * Added tag-specific search by adding '#' in the search bar. This makes it only show assets with all of those tags, for example '#park #bench modern'. * Adding tags opens a dedicated panel that shows all existing tags and allows you to search through them. * Asset creators can ship pre-defined tags with their assets.
## New Features * Added support for multi-selection of assets in the list using Ctrl+click and Shift+click. (This requires other mods' tools to support it) * Added a 'Reset View Sizes' button in the settings. * Moved the panel Width and Height options into the in-game Sorting panel instead of the mod settings. * Updated some sub-category icons for a more cohesive style. * Pressing Escape now closes the Find It panel, unless the window is locked. * Added a 'Match Letter Variants' option in the settings, so 'oeuvre' finds 'Œuvre'. Though this makes search slower. * Added a confirmation before resetting your favorites.
## Performance Improvements * Loading a city no longer freezes the game while Find It indexes assets, which is now over 10 times faster. The loading screen is about 20% shorter with the base game's + DLCs assets. * Searching is now about 20 times faster, and about 60 times faster with very large asset libraries. * Opening the Find It panel is now nearly instant, even with very large asset libraries. * Improved the speed of sorting assets, and lists are now sorted in the background so opening a category no longer stutters with large asset libraries. * Assets that other mods create or change in game (ex. a Road Builder road), no longer make the game hitch for up to half a second. * Large cities no longer stutter once a minute, even with Find It closed: placed objects are now counted about 30 times faster, and only while the panel is open. * Sorting by recently selected is now more than twice as fast.
## For Mod Developers & Asset Creators * Added a Multi-Selection API that lets FindIt connect with your mod's tool to select several assets at once. * Added a Prefab Selection API that lets other mods open Find It to select an asset of a specific type. * Asset creators can now ship tags with their assets, using the new 'FindItProperties' component or the 'EditorAssetCategoryOverride' exclude list. Players can't remove these tags. * The 'FindItProperties' component can also set an asset's Find It category, or hide it from Find It. * Added a 'Find It Properties' button to the editor's bottom bar to edit these properties on the selected asset. * Read more about the new APIs and Find It Properties in the FindIt github repository.
## Bugfixes: Search & Asset List * Fixed removed or replaced assets sometimes staying in the list. * Fixed the panel sometimes showing search results from before a reload. * Fixed searches sometimes failing or showing outdated results when assets were added or changed during the search. * Fixed a failed search leaving the loading spinner running forever over the previous results. * Fixed the 'No Pack' filter not showing as selected when it was selected. * Fixed the asset pack filter hiding assets that belong to several packs. * Fixed the building corner filter starting with no corner selected instead of 'All', which also made switching categories slower. * Fixed some props appearing twice, in two different sub-categories. * Fixed assets missing from Find It when their thumbnail can't be loaded. They now show with their category's icon. * Fixed assets with the same name swapping their numbers ('Extra Garage 1', 'Extra Garage 2') between loads.
## Bugfixes: Favorites, Tools & Stability * Fixed a crash when un-favoriting the last asset of a sub-category while viewing it in Favorites. * Fixed a crash when loading a save after selecting a Favorites sub-category that has no assets in that save. * Fixed branding assets not being selectable or favoritable when 'Hide brands from Any' is enabled. * Fixed the picker leaving objects highlighted when closed without picking anything. * Fixed the 'Locate' button skipping or repeating some placed objects, and sometimes jumping to the preview of the asset you're placing or to one just deleted. * Fixed the placed objects count and sorting by most used being up to a minute out of date when opening the panel. * Fixed using an asset sometimes counting as using another asset with the same name. * Fixed Find It throwing an error every frame on the main menu when another mod failed to load, which could keep other mods from working properly.
